descriptionMarkdown:
**Description of the ship itself**

>"Why did I do that?" class ship - speed up to 120 km/sec

>He can collect Promethium(+-59 000) and fly to the Shattered planet(9hous)(stand there, he can)

>Has a mall

>Can be powered by a nuclear or thermonuclear

> And the most important meme - Pasta!

**Tech(! - means VERY IMPORTANT)**

>Rail damage - any

>Rail speed - from 3 (not particularly important)

>!Rocket damage from 18!

>Ammunition damage from 18

>!Asteroid productivity - from 16!

**Features of work**

>It has a nuclear and thermonuclear reactor

>But the mall works when the nuclear reactor is running!

>Well, at the same time, a nuclear reactor needs a mall :D

>The mall runs on waste (so it won't work on Nauvis due to the lack of asteroids)

**Building a ship**

>We install the core(1)

>We put the ship frame(2) several times (it cannot be put in one go due to the logic of the game)

>We set finale(3) and rejoice

**There may be some bugs in it, if you find any, then sorry**

**The ship itself was created as a challenge from a friend of mine**
title: BIG SHIP (FPS eater)
